Game Overview

At its heart, Starship Troopers is a shooter game about step into the boots of a fearless trooper battling hostile forces on a lunar base. Armed with a diverse arsenal, including flamethrowers and rocket launchers, you'll navigate intense combat scenarios. Stay alert, manage your health strategically, and gather vital supplies to ensure your survival in this gripping adventure.
